lead: Context usage: a small ring with a percentage that opens a breakdown: the total, how much is used and what it is made of. The higher the usage, the more it stands out (warning color from 70%, danger color from 90%).

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: `data-level` is ok below 70%, warn from 70% and danger from 90%; usage above 100% is drawn as 100%.

api.title: API Reference
api.formatTokens: The `formatTokens(n)` helper used for the numbers is exported too: `12345` → `"12.3K"`, `128000` → `"128K"`. Used tokens not covered by `segments` show as "Other", the rest as "Free".

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The trigger (a button); `data-level` is ok / warn / danger (warning from 70%, danger from 90%)
styling.ring: The small ring (SVG), its track, the progress arc and the percentage text
styling.popup: The popover content, its heading and the total
styling.bar: The stacked bar and each segment (width from `--ctx-w`, color from `data-index`)
styling.list: The breakdown list: swatch, name and value (`data-free` marks the remaining row)
